sentences.text:
Order Sheet
 Wpc No. 2069 of 2015
 Suraj Sharma Versus State of Chhattisgarh
14.08.2023
Mr. N.K. Malviya, counsel for the Petitioner.

Mr. Prafull Bharat, Sr. Advocate assisted by Mr. B.D. Guru, counsel
 respondent No. 7/Ntpc.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed writ petition and prays for issuance of direction to Respondents No. 6 and 7 to release the land.
In view of Section 11 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 or to pay compensation along with interest.
If land is acquired than proceeding under the Act of 2013 may be initiated.

Learned counsel for the NTPC would submit that earlier proceedings acquire in land has come to end without reaching its final logical thereafter in pursuance of new land acquisition Act, 2013 proceedings were initiated and during pendency of petition, the award has been passed by the land Acquisition Officer on 31.03.2021 wherein the compensation of the land has already been assessed but it could not be deposited in view of no specific direction issued by the land acquisition officer.
This fact is also not disputed by the land acquisition officer who has submitted the affidavit before this Court wherein he has been mentioned that the award has been passed on 31.03.2023 but compensation has not been deposit.
Considering the fact that the award has already been passed the NTPC is directed to deposit the compensation within 15 days from the date of receipt of copy of this order.
List this case on 31.08.202 for final disposal in motion hearing list.

Sd/-
